四散而逃（四散而逃（第22页）场上，所有人的目光都因为江翌等人的突然出现而聚焦到了他们几人身上。还处于即将可以会好友以及自己刚“逃过一劫”的喜悦当中的龙妍，似乎丝毫也没察觉到这是暴风雨来临前的平静。中年人的身形忽然一闪，眨眼间，就来到了羽田东渡的旁边。他根本就没有任何抵抗能力似的，就被中年人摁住了肩膀。此时星陨微微的喘着粗气，他想不到自己会被眼前这个乞儿给逼得节节后退，不由心中一阵羞怒，一双阴沉的双眸此时更加的狠戾，里面都已经布满了鲜红的血丝，两排钢牙此时咬的咯咯乱响，看来他已经怒到了极点。所以哪怕她心中有一千一万个不愿意，她也不能提前结束这次的“调o教任务”。之前是她在国内苦苦盼着亲人的归来，到如今，却变成她自己要远赴异国他乡，真正是世事无常。霍北萧从没有给过她机会，没想到这一次竟然答应和她交往，并且来到墨家做客，她欣喜若狂。“第二遍，滚。同样的话我不想再说第三遍。”风落羽冷冷地看了一扭的随从一眼。谷意的右手拳头距离古辰的脑袋不到一指的距离停了下来，他先是愣在了哪里，随后怒声问道。就算是一个最低等的王国，也不可能没有天师坐镇，现在的叶凡，最多也就能同时对抗几个上位天士，至于天师，他只怕还没有这个底气。似乎察觉到了她细微的变化，霍北萧支起身来靠在床头，目光却是看向远方的风景。

Chapter 2258 Escape (page 1)
Fleeing in all directions (Fleeing in all directions (p. 22)) On the field, everyone's eyes were focused on Jiang Yi and others because of their sudden appearance. Long Yan, who was still in the joy of meeting her friends and having just "escaped a disaster", did not seem to realize that this was the calm before the storm. The middle-aged man's figure suddenly flashed, and in the blink of an eye, he came to the side of Haneda Dongdu. He offered no resistance at all. As if he had the ability, the middle-aged man held his shoulders. At this time, Xingyun was panting slightly. He didn't expect that he would be forced to retreat by the beggar in front of him. He couldn't help but feel ashamed and angry. His gloomy eyes were now even more fierce, filled with bright red bloodshot eyes. The two rows of steel teeth were clattering loudly at this time. It seemed that he was extremely angry, so even if she had 11,000 reluctances in her heart, she could not end it early. This "training mission". Before, she was waiting for the return of her relatives in China, but now, she has to go to a foreign country. Things are really unpredictable. Huo Beixiao never gave her a chance, but she didn't expect that this time he agreed to date her and came to the Mo family. She was ecstatic. "Second time, get out. I don't want to say the same thing a third time." Feng Luoyu gave the entourage a cold look. The fist of his right hand stopped less than a finger away from Gu Chen's head. He was stunned for a while, and then asked angrily. Even the lowest kingdom cannot be without a heavenly master. Now Ye Fan can only fight against several high-ranking heavenly masters at the same time. As for the heavenly master, he may not have the confidence. As if he noticed her subtle changes, Huo Beixiao stood up and leaned on the bed, looking at the scenery in the distance.
